title: SurgCast: Action-Conditioned Future Skeletons for Controllable Surgical World Models
title_zh: SurgCast：基于动作条件的未来骨骼结构，用于构建可控的外科手术世界模型

paragraphs.en: Surgical world models must turn prospective robot actions into visually faithful, structurally consistent instrument motion. We introduce SurgCast , which predicts future instrument skeletons from current structure, robot state, and future actions, then uses the forecast to control video generation. Dual-path injection combines skeleton geometry with derived, instrument-specific motion descriptors through geometric residuals and conditioning modulation. Both paths complement native action conditioning and are retained in a four-step causal student. On SutureBot and SRTH-Porcine-Cholei, the teacher and student improve all seven reported quality and instrument-consistency metrics over their respective direct-action baselines; teacher FVD decreases by 37.6% and 67.3%. Ablations show that future actions improve skeleton prediction and that combining both injection paths performs best across all six metrics under predicted skeletons. These results support using predicted articulated structure and its motion semantics as a control interface for surgical video prediction. Project videos and examples are available at https://surgcast.netlify.app/.
paragraphs.zh: 手术世界模型必须将机器人预期的动作转化为视觉上逼真且结构上连贯的器械运动。 我们提出了 SurgCast，它基于当前结构、机器人状态和预期动作预测未来器械的骨架，并利用该预测结果控制视频生成。 双路径注入通过几何残差和条件调制，将骨架几何形状与派生出的特定器械运动描述符相结合。 这两条路径都与原始动作条件相互补充，并被保留在一个四步因果学生模型中。 在 SutureBot 和 SRTH-Porcine-Cholei 上，教师模型和学生模型在所有七项报告的质量与器械一致性指标上均优于各自直接动作的基线模型；教师模型的 FVD 分别降低了 37.6% 和 67.3%。 消融实验表明，预期动作能够提升骨架预测效果，而在预测骨架条件下，结合两条注入路径的方案在所有六项指标中表现最佳。 这些结果支持将预测出的关节结构和其运动语义用作手术视频预测的控制接口。 项目视频和示例可在 https://surgcast.netlify.app/ 获取。

paragraphs.en: A surgical robot’s actions determine how instruments move within the operative scene. An action-conditioned world model should make these consequences visible before execution: different commands from the same initial view should produce different, structurally consistent motions. Visual prediction supports robot planning and interactive simulation [ 4 , 3 , 24 ] , while action-conditioned models extend video generation to manipulation and surgery [ 33 , 6 , 18 ] . For surgery, realistic appearance must accompany instrument configurations that follow the supplied commands.
paragraphs.zh: 手术机器人的操作决定了器械在手术场景中的移动方式。 一个以行动为条件的世界模型应在执行前将这些后果可视化：来自同一初始视角的不同指令应产生结构一致但不同的运动。 视觉预测支持机器人规划和交互式模拟 [ 4 , 3 , 24 ]，而以行动为条件的模型则将视频生成扩展到了操控和手术领域 [ 33 , 6 , 18 ]。 在手术中，器械的配置必须遵循所给出的指令，并呈现出逼真的外观。

paragraphs.en: Direct action conditioning leaves the generator to infer future articulated geometry in image space. Our qualitative comparisons show that recognizable scenes can coexist with instrument drift and interaction misalignment (Fig. 3 ). Trajectory and kinematic controls expose structure to video models [ 20 , 26 , 21 , 15 , 9 ] . Building on this principle, we study an explicit predictive interface: forecast the instrument configuration from current structure and prospective commands, then use that forecast to guide video generation.

paragraphs.en: Instrument skeletons connect these stages through keypoints with fixed tool-specific roles. Their trajectories also yield descriptors of image-plane translation, shaft-direction angular velocity, and projected wrist and jaw articulation. We call these instrument-meaningful motion descriptors kinematic semantics . Geometric maps locate the articulated tool, while derived descriptors expose its motion directly to the generator’s conditioning. This raises two questions: do future commands improve skeleton prediction, and does using the forecast’s geometry and kinematic semantics improve action-conditioned video generation?

paragraphs.en: Visual foresight, generative policies, and interactive simulators connect visual prediction to robot planning [ 4 , 3 , 24 ] . iVideoGPT and DINO-WM study interactive prediction and planning in visual feature spaces [ 22 , 32 ] ; IRASim, HMA, and Ctrl-World model action-conditioned visual dynamics [ 33 , 19 , 6 ] . In surgery, Open-H-Embodiment supplies paired video and kinematics [ 13 ] , and Cosmos-H-Dreams provides action-conditioned generation and causal deployment [ 18 ] . Instrument pose and tracking supply articulated image-space structure [ 30 , 23 , 5 ] , while forecasting methods predict motion or state from historical observations [ 14 , 17 ] . SurgCast predicts future structure conditioned on prospective commands and uses it as an intermediate control for video generation.

paragraphs.en: ControlNet and T2I-Adapter introduce spatial diffusion conditioning [ 31 , 11 ] ; VideoComposer, DragNUWA, and MotionCtrl extend control to video motion [ 20 , 26 , 21 ] . Surgical generators use action graphs, latent actions, object-aware features, and tool-tip trajectories [ 25 , 8 , 2 , 15 ] . KVLR projects articulated kinematics using camera parameters into image-aligned semantic, depth, orientation, velocity, and acceleration controls and routes these modalities hierarchically [ 9 ] . Our control construction first forecasts future image-space skeletons from current structure and commands. The forecast then supplies both geometric maps and instrument-motion descriptors, injected as residuals and conditioning modulation, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: ControlNet 和 T2I-Adapter 引入了空间扩散条件 [ 31 , 11 ]；VideoComposer、DragNUWA 和 MotionCtrl 将控制扩展到了视频运动中 [ 20 , 26 , 21 ]。 手术生成器使用了动作图、潜在动作、对象感知特征和工具提示轨迹 [ 25 , 8 , 2 , 15 ]。 KVLR 利用相机参数将铰接运动学投影到与图像对齐的语义、深度、方向、速度和加速度控制中，并对这些模态进行分层路由 [ 9 ]。 我们的控制构建首先基于当前结构和指令预测未来的图像空间骨架。 该预测随后提供几何地图和器械运动描述符，分别作为残差和条件调制注入。

paragraphs.en: A causal attention mask makes q h q_{h} depend on commands up to step h h , with a padding mask for variable-length sequences. Coordinates are predicted as offsets from the completed current configuration instead of accumulated frame-to-frame displacements. The implemented transformer has four layers, width 256, and eight attention heads. Per instrument, the predictor represents commands as three relative translation values, a six-dimensional relative rotation, and one absolute jaw value, normalized using training statistics. The video backbone separately constructs the corresponding 20-dimensional two-arm action representation and pads it to 44 dimensions.

paragraphs.en: PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS assess frame fidelity; FID and FVD assess image- and video-level quality. FVD uses the first 16 future frames in the SutureBot and SRTH comparisons. GT-Anchored Tool Consistency (GATC) compares grayscale appearance in ground-truth tool regions using zero-mean normalized cross-correlation, a gradient-presence penalty, and local alignment within ± 3 \pm 3 pixels and ± 1 \pm 1 frame. Tool Centroid Distance (TCD) matches Medical-SAM3 tool-mask centroids by Hungarian assignment; a missing tool incurs half the image diagonal. Both use medians over valid future frames and exclude the observed first frame. For rollout evaluation, C1–C6 partition the 72 future frames into six consecutive 12-frame segments. FDS-L1 and FDS-SSIM report segment-averaged framewise L1 error and SSIM against the ground-truth video, with RGB values normalized to [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] ; GATC and TCD are also reported by segment.
paragraphs.zh: PSNR、SSIM 和 LPIPS 用于评估帧保真度；FID 和 FVD 则用于评估图像和视频级别的质量。 在 SutureBot 和 SRTH 的比较中，FVD 使用了前 16 个未来帧。 GT-锚定工具一致性（GATC）通过零均值归一化互相关、梯度存在惩罚项以及 ±3 \pm 3 像素和 ±1 \pm 1 帧范围内的局部对齐，来比较真实数据中工具区域的灰度外观。 工具质心距离（TCD）通过匈牙利分配法匹配 Medical-SAM3 工具掩码的质心；若缺少某个工具，则惩罚值为图像对角线长度的一半。 两者均对有效未来帧计算中位数，并排除已观测到的第一帧。 在展开评估中，C1–C6 将 72 个未来帧划分为六个连续的 12 帧段。 FDS-L1 和 FDS-SSIM 分别报告了各段内逐帧 L1 误差和 SSIM 相对于真实视频的均值，其中 RGB 值已归一化至 [−1, 1]；GATC 和 TCD 的结果也按段报告。

paragraphs.en: We first ask whether the predicted structural interface improves action-conditioned video generation. Table I compares SurgCast (Predicted), our main method, with the direct-action teacher. It improves all seven reported metrics on both datasets. FVD decreases by 37.6% on SutureBot and 67.3% on SRTH-Porcine-Cholei, alongside improved GATC and TCD. The paired results show improved video quality together with closer instrument appearance and position under the supplied actions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先询问预测的结构界面是否提升了基于动作的视频生成效果。 表 I 将 SurgCast（预测版），即我们的主要方法，与直接动作教师模型进行了比较。 它在两个数据集上均提升了所有七项已报告的指标。 FVD 在 SutureBot 上降低了 37.6%，在 SRTH-Porcine-Cholei 上降低了 67.3%，同时 GATC 和 TCD 也有所改善。 配对结果表明，视频质量得到了提升，同时在给定动作下器械的外观和位置也更加接近。

paragraphs.en: Table II tests the two injection paths under predicted skeletons in the SutureBot teacher. The action-only control uses the same training recipe; all variants retain native action conditioning. Either structural path improves all six metrics over action-only. Geometry yields lower LPIPS and FID, while kinematics yields higher PSNR, SSIM, and GATC and lower TCD. Combining both paths performs best on every metric, reaching PSNR of 24.4687, LPIPS of 0.1073, and TCD of 40.37. The combined row is SurgCast (Predicted) in Table I . These results support complementary use of geometric residuals and derived motion semantics in the main predicted-skeleton generation pathway.
paragraphs.zh: 表 II 在 SutureBot 教师模型中预测的骨架下测试了两种注入路径。 仅动作控制使用相同的训练方案；所有变体均保留原始的动作条件。 无论采用哪种结构路径，其性能在所有六个指标上均优于仅动作控制。 几何路径产生的 LPIPS 和 FID 较低，而运动学路径产生的 PSNR、SSIM 和 GATC 较高，TCD 较低。 结合两种路径在所有指标上的表现最佳，达到 PSNR 24.4687、LPIPS 0.1073 和 TCD 40.37。 表 I 中结合路径对应的行即为 SurgCast（预测）。 这些结果支持在主要的预测骨架生成路径中互补使用几何残差和派生运动语义。

paragraphs.en: SurgCast establishes predicted instrument structure as an explicit interface between prospective robot actions and video generation. Its two injection paths expose the same forecast as image-aligned geometry and instrument-meaningful motion descriptors. Across the evaluated datasets, this interface improves video fidelity and instrument consistency over direct-action baselines. Ablations show that future commands improve structural forecasting and that both injection paths contribute under predicted skeletons; their combination performs best across the six SutureBot ablation metrics. The gains also persist in four-step causal generation. Together, these findings support forecasting articulated structure and explicitly using its geometry and motion semantics for surgical video control.
paragraphs.zh: SurgCast 将预测的器械结构确立为机器人预期动作与视频生成之间的显式接口。 其两条注入路径以图像对齐的几何结构和具有器械语义的动作描述符形式呈现相同的预测结果。 在评估的数据集中，该接口相较于直接动作基线模型提升了视频的保真度和器械一致性。 消融实验表明，未来指令能够改善结构预测，且两种注入路径在预测骨架下均有贡献；二者的组合在六个 SutureBot 消融指标中表现最佳。 这种改进在四步因果生成中同样持续存在。 综合来看，这些研究结果支持对可动结构进行预测，并显式利用其几何形态和运动语义来操控手术视频。
